description: What is in the local workout archive made by archive_workouts (~/.suunto-mcp/archive/, SUUNTO_ARCHIVE_DIR moves it), from the folder alone: { dir, archived (workouts whose record and FIT file check out), fitBytes, oldest, newest (local dates of the archived workouts), problems: [{ workoutKey, problem }] (a damaged or foreign record, a missing FIT file, a FIT file whose size differs from its record: never repaired or deleted), incomplete: [{ workoutKey, problem }] (a FIT file with no record, left by an interrupted archive_workouts: not counted as archived; the next archive_workouts completes it while the workout is still listed and the download is identical), otherFiles (files in the folder that are not part of the archive, never touched), notes }. A FIT file is checked by its size against its record, not read again or re-hashed. A folder that does not exist is an empty archive and is not created. Local files only: never contacts Suunto, needs no Suunto credentials, writes nothing. It cannot say how many workouts are still missing: archive_workouts reports `remaining`. In demo mode it describes the in-memory archive. Read-only.
name: get_archive_status
title: Get the local workout archive status
